critical_code_review_comments: posts_feed.py update_post endpoint is registered without a trailing slash (/posts/{post_id}); clients that call with trailing slash get a 307 redirect that drops the Authorization header and fails with 401. Not a bug per se but worth documenting for mobile clients.
Coupon public endpoint increments clicks on every GET; consider throttling or dedup by IP/session to avoid skewed stats from reload spam. Not blocking.
